title: “You Were Just Hurt” Is Church Code for ‘Shut Up’

top_liked.author: @goodgracious6364
top_liked.text: I was having a casual conversation with a co-worker about religion when I told her that I didn't go to church.  And she just randomly said, "You were hurt!".  Her comment took me off guard because it made no good sense and had absolutely nothing to do with why I chose not to…

top_liked.author: @peachypie2725
top_liked.text:
ofc i'm hurt. i lived a life based on lies for 30years.
my parents lied to me, teacher, pastors, friends, media, the whole world lie to my face. these people i trust the most.

top_liked.author: @BilboJack
top_liked.text: "You were just hurt." Stop and think about it. What kind of restaurant-manager reacts to someone boycotting their restaurant by saying "Oh. You just got food poisoning"?

top_liked.author: @neilgoloy3582
top_liked.text: Left the church after several decades, it was just a religious circus of sorts. Yes, they said I was just hurt. That's when I was laughed at and labelled a BABY CHRISTIAN, with any problems and difficulties in my life resulting from what they called "secret sins". For me the…

top_liked.text: This happens to ex-muslims all the time.  The same delegitimising argument. Isn't it funny that these religions, who often are so opposed to each other, are so similar in their fallacies and apologetics?
